hooks.name: Validate day files on save
hooks.description: tech.md quality gate: a change to content/days/*.json checks five beats, effect/delta keys against variables.json, and string keys against zh.json.

action.prompt:
A day file under content/days/ was saved. Quality gate (tech.md): run exactly this once (no pipe, so the exit code is the script's):
npm run validate -- --days
Exit 0 ("days: 18 files, 0 problems") means clean: say so in one line. Exit 1 means a day file has problems: list each reported line as-is (file, field, problem). Exit 2 means the check could not run: quote its "cannot run" message. content/ is Claude's area: do not edit it, do not commit; report only.
